verdict.rationale: llama.cpp explicitly advertises a plain C/C++, dependency-free core (gh-5), a dedicated build-from-source guide (gh-16), and the ggml backend library (gh-21); community reports confirm building/compiling from source works smoothly across platforms (comm-7, comm-13). Missing for 10: detailed contents of the build guide itself and independent verification across all supported OS/toolchains.
